| `op` | `integer` (uint64) or `null` | no | The number of the operation this undo recorded; omitted when it wrote nothing (`already_applied`). |
| `ref_moves` | array of [`RefMoveOut`](#refmoveout) | yes | The moves it made: each ref from what the operation set back to what it named before. |
| `undone` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | The operation undone. |
| `warnings` | array of `string` | no | Problems found after the undo became durable, such as failed housekeeping; the undo itself succeeded. Omitted when empty. |

## VerifyFinding

One problem `verify` found, as a program reads it: what kind of damage it is, and what it names. The keys its kind does not use are omitted; the line at the same index of `problems` says the same for a reader. Ids are lowercase hex.

Kind: object. `swarmops schema VerifyFinding` prints its JSON Schema.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cause` | `string` or `null` | no | What disagrees with the record (`index_mismatch`), which says what mends it: `journal` (rebuild the index from the journal), `sorted_view` (rebuild the sorted views from the index columns) or `object` (derive the record from its object again). |
| `changeset` | `string` or `null` | no | The changeset: the first, in seq order, that references the missing object (`missing_object`), the one that names a missing parent (`missing_parent`), the one whose root is not its first parent's root with its delta applied (`root_mismatch`), the one an external id's entry names: not in the store (`external_id_dangling`), or with a `git.oid` that is another oid than the entry's key, or, found by a deep verify, with none and exporting to another commit (`external_id_mismatch`), or the one a derived value is about (`derived_mismatch`). |
| `derivation` | `string` or `null` | no | The derivation whose stored value is not the one the objects give: `first_parent_skip_list`, `last_modified`, or a git export oid memo `git_tree_oid`, `git_blob_oid` or `git_oid`, or one of them under a memo key, `git_tree_oid_mac`, `git_blob_oid_mac` or `git_oid_mac`, whose value, or under the store's key whose MAC, does not check (`derived_mismatch`, which a deep verify finds; `git_oid` and `git_oid_mac` name their `changeset`, the tree and blob memos their `object`). Removing the value's file under `meta/derived/<derivation>/`, or all of `meta/derived/`, has it derived again. |
| `key` | `string` or `null` | no | The key, in lowercase hex: the external id whose entry it is, a git commit's oid for system `git` (`external_id_corrupt`, `external_id_dangling`, `external_id_mismatch`); or a derived value's key, its postcard bytes, omitted for a derivation whose key is `()` (`derived_mismatch`: a path's for `last_modified`; for a memo under a memo key, a `_mac` derivation, the id of the key it was made under). |
| `kind` | `string` | yes | What is damaged: `corrupt_object`, `missing_object`, `missing_parent`, `root_mismatch`, `dangling_ref`, `corrupt_ref`, `index_mismatch`, `journal_corrupt`, `meta_corrupt`, `external_id_corrupt`, `external_id_dangling`, `external_id_mismatch` or `derived_mismatch`. A string, as `OpError.code` is, so that a client can read kinds newer than its own list. |
| `object` | `string` or `null` | no | The object: one whose content does not hash to its id or does not decode (`corrupt_object`), one a changeset references that the store lacks, or holds as another kind (`missing_object`), or the tree or blob a git export oid memo (`git_tree_oid`, `git_blob_oid`, `git_tree_oid_mac`, `git_blob_oid_mac`) is about (`derived_mismatch`). |
| `offset` | `integer` (uint64) or `null` | no | Where the corrupt frame starts in `journal.log` (`journal_corrupt`); nothing after it is read. |
| `parent` | `string` or `null` | no | The parent the changeset names, which the store does not hold (`missing_parent`). |
| `ref` | `string` or `null` | no | The ref: one that names no changeset in the store (`dangling_ref`), or whose file does not read as a ref (`corrupt_ref`). |
| `seq` | `integer` (uint64) or `null` | no | The changeset record's place in the index, from 0 (`index_mismatch`). |
| `system` | `string` or `null` | no | The system of the external id index whose entry it is: `git`, whose keys are git commit oids, or another (`external_id_corrupt`, `external_id_dangling`, `external_id_mismatch`). |

## VerifyReport

`verify`: what the consistency check found.

Kind: object. `swarmops schema VerifyReport` prints its JSON Schema.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `changesets_checked` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | How many changesets were checked. |
| `findings` | array of [`VerifyFinding`](#verifyfinding) | no | One finding per problem found, for a program to act on: `findings[i]` is the problem that the line `problems[i]` describes. Empty for a clean store; a report without it reads as having none. Default: `[]`. |
| `found` | `integer` (uint64) | no | How many problems were found, listed or not; 0 from a store older than this field. Default: `0`. |
| `objects_checked` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | How many objects were checked. |
| `problems` | array of `string` | yes | One line per problem found, for a reader of lines; empty for a clean store. `findings` holds the same problems, at the same indexes, for a program. |
| `truncated` | `boolean` | no | The report lists the first `max_findings` problems only; `found` counts them all. Default: `false`. |

## VerifyReq

`verify`: check the whole store's consistency.

Kind: object. `swarmops schema VerifyReq` prints its JSON Schema.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deep` | `boolean` | no | Re-hash every object, and check every derived value of the built-in derivations (the first-parent skip lists, the last touches of paths) against the objects. When `false`, verify checks structure only: parents, that referenced objects exist, the index against the journal, and refs. Default: `false`. |
| `max_findings` | `integer` (uint32) or `null` | no | The most problems the report lists, 1 to 1,000, also the default; `found` counts them all. |

## VerifySummary

What a verify found, in counts: `repair`'s `after`.

Kind: object. `swarmops schema VerifySummary` prints its JSON Schema.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `changesets_checked` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | How many changesets were checked. |
| `found` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | How many problems were found; 0 for a sound store. |
| `objects_checked` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | How many objects were checked. |

## WsChange

One changed path of a workspace.

Kind: object. `swarmops schema WsChange` prints its JSON Schema.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | [`WsChangeKind`](#wschangekind) | yes | What changed. |
| `path` | `string` | yes | The repository path. |
| `size` | `integer` (uint64) or `null` | no | The file's size now; omitted for a deleted path. |

## WsChangeKind

What changed at a workspace path.

Kind: enumeration. `swarmops schema WsChangeKind` prints its JSON Schema.

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `"added"` | A file the head does not hold. |
| `"modified"` | Its content changed. |
| `"deleted"` | It is gone. |
| `"type_changed"` | A file became a symlink, or the other way round. |
| `"mode_changed"` | Its executable bit changed. |

## WsCheckInput

The check a workspace's land runs.

Kind: object. `swarmops schema WsCheckInput` prints its JSON Schema.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `argv` | array of `string` or `null` | no | The command and its arguments, run without a shell in the workspace; when omitted, the repository's `.swarmops/workspaces.json` `check.argv`. |
| `timeout_s` | `integer` (uint64) | no | The most seconds the command runs before it is killed. Default: `900`. |

## WsCommitReq

`ws_commit` (client-side): record a workspace's edits as one changeset on its head.

Kind: object. `swarmops schema WsCommitReq` prints its JSON Schema.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | `string` | yes | The changeset's message. |
| `modes` | map of `string` to [`ModeInput`](#modeinput) | no | A kind to record for a path, where the volume cannot hold the executable bit. |
| `paths` | array of `string` | no | Only these repository paths; one outside the prefixes is `E_WS_OUTSIDE_PREFIXES`. |
| `status_after` | [`StatusAfter`](#statusafter) | no | Whether the response carries the status after the mutation. Default: `"page"`. |
| `workspace` | `string` | yes | The workspace, by name. |

## WsCommitResp

`ws_commit`: the changeset recorded.

Kind: object. `swarmops schema WsCommitResp` prints its JSON Schema.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `blobs_written` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | How many blobs the store did not hold and got. |
| `changeset` | `string` | yes | The new changeset: the workspace's head now. |
| `files_changed` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | How many paths it changes. |
| `parent` | `string` | yes | Its parent: the head before. |
| `replayed` | `boolean` | yes | A crashed commit's key replayed: the changeset was recorded before. |
| `status_after` | [`WsStatus`](#wsstatus) or `null` | no | The status after the mutation; omitted when the request said `none`. |

## WsCreateReq

`ws_create` (M5, client-side): make a workspace, a directory holding a sparse copy of a changeset's tree. The same request again is the same workspace (`created` false).

Kind: object. `swarmops schema WsCreateReq` prints its JSON Schema.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `all` | `boolean` | no | The whole tree instead of `prefixes`. |
| `base` | [`Rev`](#rev) | no | The changeset whose tree it holds. Default: `"main"`. |
| `from` | `string` or `null` | no | A directory on the caller's host whose `.worktreeinclude` names files to copy in; when omitted, nothing is copied. |
| `name` | `string` | yes | The workspace's name: 1 to 64 of `a-z`, `0-9`, `.`, `_` and `-`, not starting with `.`. |
| `path` | `string` or `null` | no | The directory to make it in, on the caller's host; when omitted, one named after it in the working directory of the process that serves the call. |
| `prefixes` | array of `string` | no | The repository paths whose subtrees are written out. |
| `session` | `string` or `null` | no | The hook's session, 16 hex digits; set by the Claude Code hook only. |
| `status_after` | [`StatusAfter`](#statusafter) | no | Whether the response carries the status after the mutation. Default: `"page"`. |

| `rescue` | `boolean` | no | Commit its edits as a rescue changeset first. |

## WsDiffReq

`ws_diff` (client-side): a workspace's edits against its head, as the store's diff gives a diff (`from` the head, `to` `ws:<name>`).

Kind: object. `swarmops schema WsDiffReq` prints its JSON Schema.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `cursor` | `string` or `null` | no | Where the previous page stopped. |

| `limit` | `integer` (uint) | no | The most files to return: at least 1. Default: `500`. At least 1. |
| `max_bytes` | `integer` (uint64) | no | The most bytes of a `unified` page's files. Default: `32768`. |
| `paths` | array of `string` | no | Only these repository paths, and what is below them. |
| `workspace` | `string` | yes | The workspace, by name. |

## WsLandReq

`ws_land` (client-side): land a workspace's chain on its target; with a check, rebase, run the check there, and publish only the tree the check ran on.

Kind: object. `swarmops schema WsLandReq` prints its JSON Schema.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `check` | [`WsCheckInput`](#wscheckinput) or `null` | no | The check to run on the rebased tree before it lands. |
| `idempotency_key` | `string` or `null` | no | The land's key, a uuid v7; when omitted, the workspace makes one. |
| `max_attempts` | `integer` (uint32) | no | How many times to rebase, check and land before `E_CAS_RETRY_EXHAUSTED`: 1 to 32. Default: `8`. At least 1. At most 32. |
| `message` | `string` or `null` | no | The landed changeset's message, and the message to commit edits with first. |
| `mode` | [`LandMode`](#landmode) or `null` | no | `merge` or `exact`; when omitted, `exact` with a check and `merge` without. |
| `status_after` | [`StatusAfter`](#statusafter) | no | Whether the response carries the status after the mutation. Default: `"page"`. |
| `target` | `string` or `null` | no | The ref to land on; the workspace's target when omitted. |
| `workspace` | `string` | yes | The workspace, by name. |

## WsLandResp

| `land` | [`LandResp`](#landresp) | yes | The store's land. |
| `status_after` | [`WsStatus`](#wsstatus) or `null` | no | The status after the mutation; omitted when the request said `none`. |

What a workspace's rebase does.

| Value | Description |

| `"continue"` | Rebase again with the resolved conflicts. |
| `"abort"` | Leave the rebase: restore the conflicting paths from the head. |

| `status_after` | [`StatusAfter`](#statusafter) | no | Whether the response carries the status after the mutation. Default: `"page"`. |
| `workspace` | `string` | yes | The workspace, by name. |

## WsStatus

A workspace's status: its changes against its head, a page at a time, and how far its target has moved since its base.

Kind: object. `swarmops schema WsStatus` prints its JSON Schema.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base` | `string` | yes | The target's changeset its chain starts from. |
| `behind_by` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | How many changesets the target's first-parent history holds that `base`'s lacks: those past `base` when it is on that history; otherwise (a sync dropped it, or the target moved back) those before where the two histories meet, 0 when the target head is on `base`'s first-parent history fewer than 10,000 changesets behind `base`. At most 10,000. |
| `changes` | array of [`WsChange`](#wschange) | yes | The changes, by path. |
| `cursor` | `string` or `null` | no | Where this page stopped. |
| `head` | `string` | yes | Its chain's last changeset. |
| `main` | `string` | yes | The head of the workspace's target ref (`main`, or `release/<name>`), read first. |
| `name` | `string` | yes | The workspace's name. |
| `rebasing` | [`WsRebasing`](#wsrebasing) or `null` | no | The rebase in progress, when `state` is `rebasing`. |
| `state` | [`WsState`](#wsstate) | yes | Whether the workspace is rebasing. |
| `truncated` | `boolean` | yes | Whether more changes follow: give `cursor` to read them. |

| `workspace` | `string` | yes | The workspace, by name. |
